name: Busa Insure Data
description: Insurance-industry App-in-Skill for read-only data governance, backed by an operator-provisioned Busabase workspace (one Drive node for the file drive plus four Bases for QA pairs, featured information, insurer notices, and user feedback) and trusted export/restore/PDF-text-backfill scripts. Use when the user invokes $busa-insure-data or /busa-insure-data, wants an insurance data workspace with UI, needs to review insurance files, metadata completeness, QA pairs, featured information, insurer notices, or user feedback, wants to back up or restore a Busa Insure Data Busabase workspace from local PDFs, or wants Busabase Drive/Base data surfaced for data quality review and ongoing data governance.

agentPrompts.label: Show the data governance overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-insure-data` skill in this folder, then summarize the governance cockpit — record counts, data quality score, metadata field coverage, and the records that most need cleanup, across the drive and all four Bases.

agentPrompts.label: Backfill missing PDF text and metadata
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-insure-data` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run the trusted PDF-text-backfill script for the files I name using the operator's own credentials — preview first, and only add --apply once I confirm. Never write parsed_text back, only the sanitized governance metadata and the asset text slot; this app itself stays read-only and never mutates Busabase directly.
